# Frely docs

> User documentation for Frely: accounts, billing, models, FrelyMCP, the Frely CLI, and creating on Frely.

## Pages

- [Account and sign-in](https://github.com/FrelyHQ/docs/blob/main/en/faq/account.md): Creating an account, signing in, keeping it safe, and closing it.
- [Billing, Credit and refunds](https://github.com/FrelyHQ/docs/blob/main/en/faq/billing.md): Credit top-ups, Creator plans, renewal, cancellation and refunds.
- [Creating and selling on Frely](https://github.com/FrelyHQ/docs/blob/main/en/faq/creating.md): What creators can publish, what buyers receive, and how privacy of your work is handled.
- [Devices and the Frely CLI](https://github.com/FrelyHQ/docs/blob/main/en/faq/devices.md): Installing the CLI, linking a computer, keeping it working, and removing it.
- [Privacy and your data](https://github.com/FrelyHQ/docs/blob/main/en/faq/privacy-data.md): What Frely stores, for how long, and how to control analytics.
- [Using models and API keys](https://github.com/FrelyHQ/docs/blob/main/en/faq/using-models.md): API keys, client settings, usage, and what to do when a request fails.
- [Use Frely in ChatGPT](https://github.com/FrelyHQ/docs/blob/main/en/guides/chatgpt.md): Add Frely to ChatGPT as a connector, then call your Frely models from a chat.
- [Use Frely in Claude](https://github.com/FrelyHQ/docs/blob/main/en/guides/claude.md): Add Frely to Claude as a custom connector, or to Claude Code as an MCP server.
- [FrelyMCP](https://github.com/FrelyHQ/docs/blob/main/en/guides/frelymcp.md): FrelyMCP gives Claude, ChatGPT and other MCP clients access to your own computers, cloud tools, and the models and AI agents in your Frely account.
